name: MediaMind AI Widget
author: mediamindpro

sections.description:
MediaMind is an AI engagement platform built for publishers, editorial teams, and content-driven websites. This plugin connects your WordPress site to your MediaMind account in minutes, bringing a powerful AI assistant to every page and post — without touching a single line of theme code.
For tips, tutorials, and platform updates, visit the MediaMind Blog.

What problem does MediaMind solve?

Most readers scan articles, miss key points, and leave without exploring more. You invest hours writing great content, but a significant share of your audience never fully engages with it.

MediaMind fixes that by giving every reader their own AI assistant, right inside your article:

  • Readers who are in a hurry get an instant AI summary with key takeaways.
  • Curious readers can ask any question about the article and get an accurate, contextual answer — in their own language.
  • Readers who want to go deeper get personalised article recommendations that keep them on your site.
  • Your editorial team gets a content gaps dashboard: the real questions your readers ask but your content doesn’t fully answer yet — your next editorial calendar, written by your audience.

Key features

For your readers

  • AI Summary — one-click article digest with key points, so time-poor readers always get the value
  • Interactive Q&A chat — readers type any question and get a conversational, contextual answer grounded in your article
  • Suggested questions — pre-generated questions appear as clickable chips, lowering the barrier to engagement
  • Article recommendations — AI-curated “read also” cards that match the reader’s current interest
  • Persistent chat — the reader’s conversation is saved across sessions; they pick up right where they left off
  • Multilingual — widget interface and AI responses in French or English (auto-detected or set per site)

For your editorial team

  • Content gaps — ranked list of reader questions that your content does not yet answer
  • Trending topics — real-time view of which subjects are driving the most reader curiosity
  • Engagement analytics — reads, questions asked, interaction rate, time spent — per article and globally
  • AI editorial consultant — an AI chat assistant that discusses content strategy with you, based on your actual reader data (Pro/Scale plans)
  • AI recommendations engine — automated “what to write next” suggestions derived from reader behaviour (Pro/Scale plans)

For your development team

  • REST API — full access to pages, analytics, Q&A, and recommendations from any system
  • Webhooks — real-time push notifications when content is synced, questions asked, or anomalies detected
  • HTML zones — drop lightweight

* Headless-ready — works with Next.js, Nuxt, Gatsby, or any front-end via the JavaScript snippet

How the WordPress plugin works

  1. Install and activate the plugin, then enter your Widget Key in Settings > MediaMind.
  2. The AI widget is automatically injected on every post and page — a floating button that opens an AI panel with a Summary tab, a Q&A chat tab, and article recommendations — without any theme modification.
  3. The widget resolves the current page automatically via its URL — no manual sync required.
  4. You can optionally place HTML zone tags in your templates for a fully inline, design-native experience.

HTML zones (optional, advanced)

Instead of the default floating chat button, you can embed AI content directly into your article layout:

<div id="mm-summary"></div>

Renders an inline AI summary with key points.

<div id="mm-questions"></div>

Renders a set of suggested question chips for readers to click.

<div id="mm-chat"></div>

Renders a full inline chat panel — ideal for dedicated AI assistant pages.

These zones are design-neutral: MediaMind adapts its colours and fonts to your dashboard settings; you control the surrounding layout.

Plans

  • Free — 5,000 AI interactions/month, up to 25 pages, 1 site, 7-day analytics. No credit card required.
  • Starter ($39/mo) — 10,000 interactions/month, up to 500 pages, 1 site, 30-day analytics, bulk import, REST API, webhooks.
  • Pro ($149/mo) — 50,000 interactions/month, unlimited pages, 3 sites, full analytics history, AI insights, AI recommendations engine, up to 10 team members.
  • Scale ($399/mo) — 200,000 interactions/month, unlimited pages, 10 sites, all Pro features, unlimited team members.

Sign up free at https://mediamind.pro.

External Services

This plugin connects to the MediaMind API, an external AI engagement service operated by MediaMind.

What the service does: MediaMind indexes your content and provides AI-generated summaries, Q&A chat, and article recommendations to your readers.

What data is sent and when:

  • On front-end page load: The Widget Key is embedded in the page source and used to load the AI widget script from the MediaMind servers. The current page URL is passed to the widget so it can display the correct AI content.
  • On reader interaction: When a visitor uses the AI widget (opens a summary, types a question, or requests recommendations), their query text and the current page URL are transmitted to MediaMind servers for AI processing. No personally identifiable information (name, email, login data) is collected by the plugin or transmitted to MediaMind.

Service endpoint: https://api.mediamind.inoutconnect.com

A MediaMind account is required to use this plugin. The free plan requires no credit card.

  • Service website: https://mediamind.pro
  • Terms of Service: https://news.mediamind.pro/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://news.mediamind.pro/privacy.html
  • Blog & documentation: https://blog.mediamind.pro/

Privacy

This plugin does not set any cookies directly. The MediaMind JavaScript widget may store a session token in localStorage on the reader’s browser in order to maintain persistent chat history across page loads. No tracking cookies are set.

Data transmitted to MediaMind:

  • Reader interaction data (client-side): Query text and page URL — sent only when a reader actively uses the AI widget.
  • No PII is collected by default. The plugin does not transmit reader IP addresses, email addresses, or WordPress user data.

Site administrators can delete all reader interaction data for their site from the MediaMind dashboard at any time. MediaMind does not sell reader data to third parties.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation (recommended)

  1. In your WordPress Dashboard go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for MediaMind AI Widget.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Settings > MediaMind and enter your Widget Key.
  5. Click Save Settings.

Manual installation

  1. Download the mediamind-ai-widget.zip file.
  2. In your WordPress Dashboard go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the .zip file and click Install Now, then Activate.

Where to find your Widget Key

  1. Sign in to your MediaMind dashboard at https://mediamind.pro.
  2. Go to Widget & API > API Keys.
  3. Copy your Widget Key (prefix: mmnd_pub_).
sections.faq:
What is MediaMind?

MediaMind is an AI engagement and analytics platform for publishers. It reads your articles, builds an AI knowledge base, and gives your readers an intelligent assistant while giving your editorial team actionable intelligence.

Do I need a MediaMind account?

Yes. This plugin connects to the MediaMind external service and requires an active account to function. A free account is available at https://mediamind.pro.

Will the widget slow down my site?

No. The widget script loads asynchronously and has no render-blocking impact on page load. All AI processing happens server-side.

Is my Widget Key exposed to visitors?

The Widget Key (mmnd_pub_) is intentionally designed to be safe in public HTML — it is strictly read-only and cannot write data, access billing information, or perform any administrative action.

Which post types are supported?

By default: Posts and Pages.

Does it support multilingual sites?

The widget language can be set to French or English. It auto-detects the site language by default.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Removed server-side content sync — widget now resolves articles automatically via page URL.
  • Removed Server API Key requirement — only the Widget Key (mmnd_pub_) is needed.
  • Widget injection now uses window.MEDIAMIND_CONFIG for improved compatibility.
  • Updated widget CDN to app.mediamind.pro.

1.0.1

  • Removed Server API Key from admin interface.
  • Widget Key now used for all API authentication.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Automatic content sync (Posts, Pages, Products).
  • Floating AI widget with Summary, Q&A, and Recommendations.
  • HTML zones support (mm-summary, mm-questions, mm-chat).
  • Secure API key management (Server vs Widget keys).
